text:
ava: heads-up — last nights canary rollback sprayed alerts across tenant channels. looks like suppression didnt apply. anyone see the root cause?

liam: yep. telemetry shows notify_fanout_count jumped to 134 for tenant=acme-inc. suppression tag missing on fanout trace.

simone: thats the new 'suppress-on-rollback' flow not firing. we intended a simulate-first UX so oncall can preview impact.

raj: brief summary from runtime: console writes a suppression intent record -> deploy-bot emits rollback event -> notify pipeline should match intent and run transform. mismatch happened because the intent id was namespaced by deploy.region and the event used deploy.location.

joan: oy. key normalization bug. should be easy to align, but we also need to think about UX: people want a one-click console action that shows expected pings and savings before committing.

ava: proposal: console action with simulate=true that calls notify-service simulate endpoint. return estimated_fanout, impacted_contacts list, and estimated_cost_delta. the modal shows a diff and a warning if any on-call rotations will be skipped.

liam: runtime detail: for simulate we can reuse the same transform logic but flag read-only; compute adjusted_weight and filtered_contacts. must ensure simulate path uses same routing paths as real path to avoid mismatch.

simone: implementation debate: should simulate be performed inline in notify-service or via a separate estimator microservice? inline reduces drift but adds synchronous latency to UI. estimator reduces latency but might diverge. I prefer inline with a small timeout (500ms) and fallback to async estimation if it times out.

raj: agree on inline with timeout. also add a consistency window for deploy metadata sync (2s) before we finalize routing keys for events labeled deploy.*; reduces the race.

joan: quota billing question: when soft-suppress adjusts weight, should tenant quota usage reflect adjusted weight? customer-facing expectation is cost saved when suppressed.

liam: yes — adjusted_weight should be used for quota/accounting. for hard-suppress (mute) mark usage zero but emit a suppression_billing_tag so finance reconciles.

simone: telemetry: we need metrics: notify.suppression.applied{mode,trigger,tenant}, notify.suppression.simulated{tenant}, notify.suppression.fanout_delta and logs with fanout_decision {orig_fanout,adj_fanout,orig_weight,adj_weight,reason}. also an audit event in policy history: who invoked, payload, trace_id.

ava: UX safety: show a banner when simulate indicates any skipped escalation contact or missing rotations: "This suppression will skip on-call rotations X and Y. Proceed?" link to runbook.

raj: API sketch: POST /v1/notify/suppress {tenant,mode, duration, meta, simulate=(true|false)} returns {applied: bool, estimated_fanout: number, estimated_cost_delta: string, impacted_contacts: ["name1","rot1"], trace_id: string}. if simulate=true, applied=false. keep response minimal for UI.

liam: also add a bulk-preview variant: POST /v1/notify/suppress/simulate-bulk {policy_selector,...} -> aggregated estimates across policies. handy for platform leads.

simone: edge-case: multi-tenant customers with delegated escalation groups — some customers route preview contacts to a separate external system (PagerY). simulate must call external contact-resolver in read-only mode; cache results for 30s to limit calls.

joan: UX: estimate numbers should include confidence band (low/med/high) since we can only approximate concurrency and deduping. display as: "Estimated fanout: 120 → 30 (±10)". also surface last-suppression-run and recent simulate history.

ava: security/audit: every suppress action (simulate or apply) must write an immutable audit record with actor, reason, and trace_id. retention 90 days by default.

raj: dev plan proposal:
- week 1: small fix for key normalization + 2s metadata hold (hotfix)
- week 2: implement transform in notify-service and simulate endpoint (POC)
- week 3: console modal + estimate UI + confidence bands
- week 4: quota/billing integration + audit events + staging tests

liam: test plan: run simulate on staging with a copy of contact maps, verify estimated_fanout within ±15% of actual when applied. add synthetic runbook scenarios.

simone: also add a postmortem tool: replay incident id to show fanout_decision timeline so we can answer "why did we ping X?"

notify-bot: deploy d4c2e rollback started 2026-03-21T02:11:07Z — canary failed, rollback initiated :rotating_light:

ava: ok thanks. liam & raj pair on key normalization tomorrow; simone will start simulate endpoint spec; joan will mock modal and banners. i'll circulate the staging gating checklist. :thumbsup:
